text:
aisha: Heads-up — helm chart for gpu-scheduler is dropping the nodeSelector when users leave gpu.enabled undefined, so pods end up on cpu nodes in staging :grimacing:
ben: oh no, that explains the OOMs we saw in the nightly canary, thx for flagging
marco: can you paste the values.yaml and rendered template? suspecting omitEmpty or a nil map coalescing issue
aisha: values snippet:```yaml
nodeSelector: null
resources: {}
gpu:
  enabled: null
```
marco: template snippet from templates/deployment.yaml:```yaml
nodeSelector: {{- toYaml .Values.nodeSelector | nindent 8 }}
```
marco: if .Values.nodeSelector is null, toYaml renders "null" -> manifest contains `nodeSelector: null` which K8s treats as empty and the chart inherits cluster default scheduling -> lost GPU label
priya: hmm we usually guard with `{{- if .Values.nodeSelector }}...{{- end }}` but that breaks when values are set to `{}` vs `null` depending on helmfile/CI population
aisha: the gitops pipeline (flux) is injecting empty maps for staging but local `helm template` outputs differ. env drift between local/ci is biting us again
ben: quick fix: change template to:```gotmpl
{{- if and .Values.nodeSelector (ne (kindOf .Values.nodeSelector) "string") -}}
nodeSelector: {{ toYaml .Values.nodeSelector | nindent 8 }}
{{- end -}}
```
priya: or explicitly coerce in values.schema.json with default {} for nodeSelector so Helm won't get nulls from the generator
marco: helm3 also has `default` helper pattern: `{{- $ns := default (dict) .Values.nodeSelector }}` then `toYaml $ns` — that prevents `null` -> `null` render
aisha: can someone open a quick PR? we'll need tests in chart-testing and a values-schema addition. also add a lint rule: fail when toYaml is used on potentially-null map without default/if guard
ben: I'll do the PR. Add a unit test in charts/tests/render that runs `helm template` with `--set nodeSelector=null` and asserts no `nodeSelector: null` in output
deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for branch ben/fix-omit-null-nodeSelector — helm-lint -> chart-test -> integration-staging
priya: fyi we should also patch docs in chart README to mention expected shape of nodeSelector and that UI may send nulls
marco: long-term we should add a small `helm-template-guard` helper in _helpers.tpl to canonicalize maps and arrays
aisha: great. thanks team :thumbsup: will monitor staging once PR merges
ben: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/642 — includes fix + test + schema
marco: leaving a note for oncall: @oncall if anything spikes after deploy ping here, might be rollout related to nodeSelector behavior
priya: added issue to infra-board: "helm: nodeSelector null rendering causes scheduling drift" with links to PR and logs
aisha: perfect, closing loop. next step: add a short lint rule to repo's .ci to catch similar regressions
